name: aelig-human-art
description: HumanArt: on-chain-backed physical artwork certification with immutable AES NFC tags and World ID artist attribution.

scripts.check: pnpm check:docs && pnpm check:lint && pnpm check:types && pnpm check:test
scripts.check:types: pnpm --filter @humanart/shared typecheck && pnpm --filter @humanart/contracts typecheck && pnpm --filter @humanart/world-service typecheck && pnpm --filter @humanart/relayer-service typecheck && pnpm --filter @humanart/e2e-tests typecheck && pnpm --filter @humanart/web typecheck
scripts.check:test: pnpm --filter @humanart/shared test && pnpm --filter @humanart/contracts test && pnpm --filter @humanart/world-service test && pnpm --filter @humanart/relayer-service test && pnpm --filter @humanart/e2e-tests test && pnpm --filter @humanart/web test
